title: Musical composition example map
status: working editorial proposal; MIDI-first direction, no new media imported or authored
scope: 60 proposed core candidates plus an index covering all 49 current articles. These overlap and are not 109 distinct articles. Sixteen current articles have an additional demonstration brief outside the core shortlist. Collection names and membership remain unchanged pending taxonomy review.
direction: Prefer accurate, usable MIDI excerpts of recognizable repertoire for note/rhythm/structure teaching. Pair with clearly labeled original transformations where valuable. Use original or cleared local audio for sound, spatial and vocal mechanisms; external video becomes optional context.

porch.title: Porch Light
porch.status: Existing original material; new variations are briefs.
porch.description: 84 bpm, C-major vocal-song material; seed E4–G4–A4, durations 1–1–2 quarter-note beats. Preserve canonical verse/chorus identity and label changes.

platform.title: Platform Three
platform.status: Existing original material; percussion and expanded arrangements are briefs.
platform.description: 104 bpm, D-centered instrumental/groove sketch; preserve bass-cell identity. New drum parts are original proposed material.

foundation.title: Foundation miniatures
foundation.status: Existing foundation comparisons plus proposed extensions.
foundation.description: Short isolated interval, scale, home, chord-family and transposition comparisons, connected to the relevant article.

voices.title: Two Voices
voices.status: Proposed original example family; not authored.
voices.description: Two independent singable lines in a short stated harmonic setting. No borrowed melody or automatic claim of strict-species counterpoint.

pulse.title: Shared Pulse
pulse.status: Proposed original example family; visual prototype includes a separate 3:2 sketch.
pulse.description: Two distinct percussion sounds with a shared cycle marker. Phasing and simultaneous different subdivisions are separate examples.

air.title: Air Study
air.status: Proposed original sound family; not rendered.
air.description: A simple sustained pitched source and separately controlled noise; original envelope and spectrum comparisons.

room.title: Room Study
room.status: Proposed original audio family; not recorded or rendered.
room.description: Original separated plucks and background sounds with controlled dry/wet, width and position variants.

glass.title: One Pluck
glass.status: Proposed original recorded-source family; not recorded.
glass.description: One self-recorded pluck/tap becomes slices, textures and layers. Keep a source-lineage map.

process.title: Composition decision snapshots
process.status: Existing prose examples plus proposed staged presentations.
process.description: Short branches or successive states of original material; some decisions need text rather than additional audio controls.

notes.title: Pitched-note playback
notes.current_state: Existing scheduler and roll provide a base; author the specific example and preserve pitch spelling.

comparison.title: Named A/B or A/B/C versions
comparison.current_state: Prototyped only; production needs linked versions, declared change, and position mapping or restart when lengths differ.

parts.title: Named part isolation
parts.current_state: Existing switches use fixed Melody/Chords/Bass roles; generalize for voices, drums and arbitrary layers.

percussion.title: Basic drum playback and beat view
percussion.current_state: Prototyped only; production needs kick/snare/hat or neutral percussion, accents and counted rests.

timing.title: Precise subdivision and expressive timing
timing.current_state: Fractional starts already play; preserve structural timing separately from performed offsets and engrave tuplets/swing accurately.

harmony.title: Pitch, scale-degree and harmony annotations
harmony.current_state: Progression editor exists; add authored alignment and correct spellings for chromatic/borrowed notes without requiring editable harmony.

sections.title: Musical context and section navigation
sections.current_state: Existing roll pages bars; add named ranges, preparation/arrival context and shared position across zoom levels.

audio.title: Local authored-audio comparison
audio.current_state: Not in the original note player; support pre-rendered original clips without external video, including clean loop points and effect tails.

velocity.title: Authored note dynamics
velocity.current_state: Current Note data has no per-event velocity. Preserve MIDI velocity and allow authored dynamics without adding a master volume slider.

stages.title: Named stages or source lineage
stages.current_state: Show related versions with the stated decision; no requirement for a full editor or live resampling.

text.title: Aligned text or lyric context
text.current_state: Existing prose is available; add syllable/phrase alignment where the example needs it. Use original or cleared lyric text.

voice.title: Original performed voice audio
voice.current_state: Synthesized notes cannot demonstrate speech stress or delivery alone; record a small original comparison and align it to the phrase.

midi.title: Curated MIDI excerpt import
midi.current_state: New ingest step: retain tracks, channels, note timing/durations/velocity, tempo/meter maps and provenance. Parse a copy, not the canonical teaching source.

notation.title: Switchable musical notation
notation.current_state: Prototyped with VexFlow; author spelling, ties, rests, tuplets and voice/staff assignment. Raw MIDI does not supply reliable engraving semantics.
